params.body:
v0.13.1 carries the case-insensitive token lookup (#16) and is the first release a runner built (`release.yml`, from the tagged commit, checksums in SHA256SUMS). The boot script pins the gateway at that sha; `rehearse.sh upgrade` carries the script and reboots.

Proposed through the gateway under `#agent-workbench`.
params.title: De VM op v0.13.1: de release die een runner bouwde
